player_prompt.intro:
Wo ne Agodifo {player_id} wɔ Nim.
Wo botae ne sɛ woafa biribi a aka no.
Wɔ n'aberɛ biara mu no, fa pile baako pɛ na yi biribi biako anaa pii afi mu.
Fa '[pile quantity]' nhyehyɛeɛ no, baako a pile yɛ pile index na quantity yɛ biribi a wopɛ sɛ woyi afi mu no dodo.
Sɛ nhwɛsoɔ, '[0 3]' yi biribi 3 afi pile 0 mu.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Wannya format a edi mu biara. Fa '[pile quantity]' di dwuma.
invalid_move.correct_format_wrong_fields: Player {player_id}, Adwuma a woyɛ no yɛ saa. Column {col} no wɔ mmeaɛ.
invalid_move.non_positive: Ɛsɛ sɛ woyi ade biako bi fi hɔ.
invalid_move.exceeds_pile: Wontumi nfi {quantity} fi kɔla {pile_index} mu (wɔkaa {pile_count} nkoaa).

observation.removed_from_piles: Player {player_id} dii dwuma '[{pile_index} {quantity}]', na ofii {quantity} biribi fi kɔla {pile_index} mu.

outcome.win: Ɔbɔadeɛ {player_id} na ɔfaa ade a etwa to no!
